reviews.t: they look beautiful and natural on and are light weight
reviews.x: This is my second time ordering these lashes. By now, I have worn the first pair. Not only is the packaging cute, they look beautiful and natural on and are light weight. So nice, I ordered another pair the day I had them on for the first time! The packaging was even cuter on the second order. claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as beautiful, gorgeous, and full, and many say they receive compliments when wearing them.
Many customers say they love the lashes and plan to repurchase or make them their go-to.
Several reviewers praise the luxurious, sturdy packaging.
Some reviewers report durability problems, with lashes falling apart or only lasting a couple of wears.
A few reviewers complain about the look or value, saying the lashes appear pointy/cheap or are not worth the price.
